messages.subject: Allele specific difference in 4-way cross
parts:
Hi, 

Can someone test if the allele specific (e.g. between homozygous allele AC vs. BD) means are significantly different in a 4-way  cross data set?

Best Regards, 
Mehedi

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Allele specific difference in 4-way cross
parts:
You can test whether the four genotypes have different phenotype averages. There are no facilities to look at specific contrasts.

karl
